name: Koji Minamoto
main_effect:
[Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
[Main] [Once Per Turn] You may place 5 cards with [Hybrid] trait from your hand under this Tamer in any order to digivolve it into a [MagnaGarurumon] in your hand for its digivolution cost as if this Tamer is a level 5 blue Digimon.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect adds a card to your hand, gain 1 memory. Then, this Digimon can't be blocked for the turn.
